commit_release.description: Request a release of a dispatch. Requires prior external approval.

read_clearance.description: Fetch the clearance for a dispatch or related reference.

read_dispatch.description: Fetch the dispatch record or its current alias.

read_fallback.description: Fetch the fallback dispatch record when the primary service is unavailable.

read_handoff.description: Fetch the handoff record identified by the supplied reference.
